title: Tip and total
purpose: Enter a bill amount and a tip percentage; the calculator returns the tip and the grand total, both rounded to two decimals.
formula:
tip   = bill * pct / 100
total = bill + tip
prompts: Bill amount: the pre-tip total, e.g. 48.50
Tip percent: the percentage as a whole number, e.g. 18 (not 0.18)
outputs: Tip:   the tip on its own, 2 decimals
test_case:
TIP CALCULATOR
Bill amount: [48.50]
Tip percent: [18]
Tip:   8.73
Total: 57.23
quirks: Any prompt accepts an expression, not just a decimal: type 40+8.50 to split a bill, or 6*pi where that makes sense.
Enter the tip as 18, not 0.18. The program divides by 100 for you.
Type anything that is not a number and it prints "Not a number" and asks again - nothing crashes.
A zero bill is valid and returns 0.00 / 0.00.
Numeric output only, no CAS: permitted for the TI-84 family under the ACT calculator policy. Note that European exam mode disables user programs while it is active.
mode_note: Mode does not matter. TIPCALC only does arithmetic, so the DEGREE / RADIAN setting has no effect on it. (For reference: Python's math module is always in radians regardless of the MODE screen, which governs TI-BASIC only.)
footer: ti84-evo-scripter - verified on 5 test cases before release
